summary_1line: Arjuna defeats Trigarta warriors who submit, then pursues the Ashvamedha horse to Pragjyotisha and battles Vajradatta riding a furious war elephant.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna’s Gandiva slips from his bloodied hand and falls to the earth like Indra’s rainbow as the young warrior Dhritavarman laughs in battle.
Prince Vajradatta charges on a gigantic rutting elephant streaming ichor, looming like a moving mountain as Arjuna stands ready with the Gandiva.
Arjuna’s blazing arrows strike the elephant so that blood pours from its body like red streams running down a mountain.
